title: 第23章 混沌灵根大巫出世第24章 教导大巫放其离去
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
将造化青莲成功带回回盘古神殿，彻底隔绝了外界的天道窥探与压迫后，帝江这才有闲暇，仔细打量这株费了他一番功夫才保全下来的先天灵根。
造化青莲静静地悬浮在神殿中央，扎根于帝江引来的精纯灵气之中。
三十六品莲瓣缓缓开合，每一片都青翠欲滴，流淌着如玉般温润的光泽！
其上天然形成的道纹玄奥莫测，仿佛阐述着生命创造、万物轮回的至高妙理。
莲台之上，氤氲的造化之气凝结成露，散发着令人心旷神怡的清香。
帝江越看越是心惊，越看越是欢喜。
发现这造化青莲的气息浩如烟海，深邃无比。
其内蕴含的造化本源与大道法则，似乎隐隐超越了他所拥有的混沌钟！
混沌钟乃是先天至宝，可镇压鸿蒙世界，拥有平定地水火风、转化阴阳五行、演变时空大道之无上威能。
可眼前这株青莲，给帝江的感觉，却更加古老、更加本源，仿佛直指那混沌未开、万物之始的源头！
“这，莫非已超越了先天至宝的范畴？”
先天至宝乃是洪荒天地孕育灵宝的极致，但在其之上，还有更强大的混沌灵宝，混沌至宝！
不过这造化青莲应当属于混沌灵根了！
而且帝江感觉到这株青莲并非已经固定不变。
在盘古神殿这处不受天道压制、且充满盘古本源气息的完美环境中，它那原本因天道压迫而停滞的生长，似乎，又重新开始了！
莲瓣的色泽更加深邃，道纹更加复杂，整体散发出的道韵和灵压，都在以一种极其缓慢、但却真实不虚的速度，在提升！
它本是最接近混沌青莲的嫡系后裔，底蕴深厚，若非天道压制，其成长潜力不可限量！
如今在这盘古神殿，压制不再，它自然可以继续汲取养分，向着其最初的源头，混沌青莲的方向缓慢进化！
虽然这个过程注定会极其漫长，可能需要无数个元会，甚至需要难以想象的机缘和资源，但至少，是有希望的！
一件有潜力成长为混沌至宝的宝物，其价值，根本无法估量！

帝江看着造化青莲的眼神，顿时变得更加炽热和小心翼翼。
这已经不是一件简单的宝物了，这是值得他用尽心血去培养的镇运之基！
帝江立刻行动起来，不惜耗费盘古血池逸散出的本源气血，缓缓滋养青莲的根部。
又调动神殿内汇聚的先天灵气，形成灵雾，将其笼罩。
他甚至开始思考，未来是否可以去寻找一些混沌元气或者其他对灵根进化有益的天地奇珍来加速这个过程。
“好好好！
当真是意外之喜！”
帝江抚掌而笑，心情畅快至极。
保全造化青莲，本是帝江为了阻止其被三清瓜分，并增强自身底蕴。
却没想到，此举竟为他带来了一个超越先天至宝、拥有成长为混沌至宝的灵根！
帝江悉心安置好造化青莲，正为其无穷潜力而欣喜之时，盘古神殿内那浩瀚无垠的血池，突然剧烈地翻腾起来！
磅礴的气血之力如同海啸般涌动，第一个血胎轰然破裂，一道璀璨的神光冲天而起！
神光之中，一头神俊非凡、生有九首的巨鸟仰天长鸣！
其声清越，带着风雷之音！
随即神光收敛，化为一位身姿高挑、容颜绝丽、眉宇间带着一丝英气与傲然的宫装女子。
其脚踏麒麟靴立于血浪之上，周身流转着金、木、水、火、土、阴、阳、风、雷九种法则道韵，虽然气息尚有些不稳，但那大罗金仙初期的修为却做不得假。
美眸流转，看向帝江，带着孺慕与亲近，盈盈一拜，声音清脆：
“九凤，拜见大哥！
content_en:
After successfully bringing the Creation Green Lotus back to the Pangu Temple, and completely cutting off the prying eyes and oppression of the outside world, Di Jiang had time to carefully look at the innate spiritual root that had taken him a lot of effort to preserve.
The Green Lotus of Creation is suspended quietly in the center of the temple, rooted in the pure spiritual energy drawn by the Emperor River.
Thirty-six lotus petals slowly opened and closed, each piece was green and dripping with a warm luster like jade!
The naturally formed Tao patterns on it are mysterious and unpredictable, seeming to expound the supreme principles of the creation of life and the reincarnation of all things.
On the lotus platform, the dense air of creation condenses into dew, exuding a refreshing fragrance.
The more Di Jiang looked, the more frightened he became, and the more he looked, the happier he became.
I found that the aura of the Green Lotus of Creation was vast and profound.
The origin of creation and the laws of the great road contained in it seem to vaguely surpass the chaos clock he owns!
The Chaos Bell is an innate treasure that can suppress the world of Hongmeng. It has the supreme power to calm the earth, water, fire and wind, transform the yin and yang and the five elements, and evolve the avenue of time and space.
But the green lotus in front of him gave Dijiang the feeling that it was more ancient and more original, as if it was pointing directly to the source of the unopened chaos and the beginning of all things!
"Could this go beyond the realm of innate treasures?"
The innate treasure is the ultimate in spiritual treasures nurtured by the ancient world, but above it, there is a more powerful chaos spiritual treasure, the chaos treasure!
However, this green lotus should belong to the spiritual root of chaos!
Moreover, Di Jiang felt that this green lotus was not fixed.
In the Pangu Temple, a perfect environment that is not suppressed by Heaven and is full of the aura of Pangu's origin, its growth that was originally stagnant due to the oppression of Heaven seems to have started again!
The color of the lotus petals is deeper, the Dao patterns are more complex, and the overall Dao charm and spiritual pressure emitted are increasing at an extremely slow but real speed!
It is the direct descendant closest to the Chaos Green Lotus. It has a profound heritage. If it were not suppressed by heaven, its growth potential would be unlimited!
Now that it is no longer suppressed in Pangu Temple, it can naturally continue to absorb nutrients and slowly evolve towards its original source, the Chaos Green Lotus!
Although this process is destined to be extremely long, may require countless meetings, and may even require unimaginable opportunities and resources, at least there is hope!
The value of a treasure that has the potential to grow into a Chaos Treasure is simply immeasurable!
Di Jiang's eyes suddenly became more intense and cautious when he looked at Creation Qinglian.
This is no longer a simple treasure, it is the foundation of luck that is worthy of his efforts to cultivate!
Di Jiang immediately took action, and did not hesitate to consume the original energy and blood escaping from the Pangu blood pool to slowly nourish the roots of Qinglian.
He also mobilized the innate spiritual energy gathered in the temple to form a spiritual mist, covering it.
He even began to think about whether he could look for some chaotic energy or other treasures of heaven and earth that were beneficial to the evolution of spiritual roots in the future to speed up the process.
“Okay, okay!
What an unexpected surprise! "
Di Jiang smiled while stroking his palms, feeling extremely happy.
The purpose of preserving Qinglian was to prevent Dijiang from being divided by the Three Purities and to enhance his own heritage.
Unexpectedly, this move actually brought him a spiritual root that surpassed the innate treasure and grew into a chaos treasure!
Dijiang carefully arranged the Green Lotus of Creation, and just when he was delighted with its infinite potential, the vast blood pool in the Pangu Temple suddenly began to churn violently!
The majestic power of Qi and blood surged like a tsunami. The first blood fetus suddenly burst, and a bright divine light rose into the sky!
In the divine light, an extraordinary and handsome giant bird with nine heads looked up to the sky and sang!
Its voice is clear and clear, with the sound of wind and thunder!
Immediately, the divine light converged and transformed into a tall, beautiful woman in palace attire with a hint of heroism and pride between her brows.
He stands on the blood waves with his unicorn boots, and metal, wood, water, fire, earth, yin, yang, wind, etc. flow around his body.Although the aura of the Nine Thunder Laws and Daoyun is still a bit unstable, the early cultivation level of Daluo Jinxian cannot be faked.
Her beautiful eyes turned to look at Di Jiang, with admiration and closeness, she bowed and said in a clear voice:
"Jiu Feng, meet my eldest brother!
